topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: The young lad who always sat by the hearth, more bookish than the rest, now faces whispers and cold shoulders. They say he took words, not his own, and made them into his lesson. It's a heavy accusation, one that weighs more than the bales we lift at harvest. I see the way his eyes avoid the village square, how he walks a path less traveled. We all make mistakes, missteps in the furrows of our lives. It's the soil of our souls that must be tended, for even in the darkest of times, a seed planted in good faith can still bring a harvest. May the saints guide him, as they guide us all, to find his way back to the light.
